issues: 白底中灰字、浅灰胶囊，前半段画面几乎没有颜色和光，像原片的线稿
成品页版式简单：标题 + 三行正文，缺少能说明"标签"功能的上下文
胶囊质感平，第一次硬切的"成了"缺少重量
两段画面同为浅色，第二次硬切的冲击力只靠配色变化
changes: look 改 paper，前半段反用它的墨色做暖墨暗场（顶光 + 颗粒），打字放大到 180px Futura，朱红恒亮光标是唯一颜色；第二次硬切整页翻成纸白，明暗翻转放大了"啪"
实体化仍是 1 帧硬切：奶油色厚胶囊带受光上沿、体积渐变与两层暖影，浮起 16px，舞台顶光同帧提亮一档；仅 3f 1.03→1 微落定
缩移 16f bezier(0.5,0,0.25,1) 到 0.3x，后半程落地、按速度加方向性运动模糊，终点是成品页标签行的真实槽位（Q9）
成品页做成完整笔记应用「Tern」：左栏标签列表（#music 高亮计数 12）、面包屑、132px 标题、胶囊 + Add tag 幽灵按钮、46px 正文、关联笔记行
时长 120f → 132f，揭示后 41f hold 加 1→1.015 极缓推镜
issuesEn: White field, mid-grey type and a pale grey pill — the first half has almost no color or light, like a wireframe of the source
The finished page is a title plus three lines, with no context explaining what tags do
The pill is flat, so the first hard cut lacks weight
Both halves are light, so the second hard cut relies only on a palette swap
changesEn: Paper look, with the first half using its ink as a warm dark stage (top light, grain), 180px Futura typing and a steady vermilion caret as the only color; the second hard cut flips the page to paper white, amplifying the snap

Materialize stays a 1-frame hard cut: a thick cream pill with lit rim, volume gradient and warm two-layer shadow, lifted 16px, while the stage key light steps up in the same frame; only a 3f 1.03→1 settle
16f bezier(0.5,0,0.25,1) shrink to 0.3x that lands in its second half with directional motion blur, ending in the real tag slot of the page (Q9)
The finished page is a full notes app 'Tern': tag sidebar (#music highlighted, count 12), breadcrumb, 132px title, pill + ghost 'Add tag', 46px body and a linked-notes row
120f → 132f with a 41f hold and a slow 1→1.015 push after the reveal
